added.statement: The managed mise tool registry shall select npm:@openai/codex at the established latest policy and shall not select aqua:openai/codex.
acceptance_criteria: config/mise/config.toml contains npm:@openai/codex with value latest
config/mise/config.toml contains no aqua:openai/codex entry
the focused static test fails against the pre-change provider selection

ears.response: select the npm Codex provider that preserves the executable helper layout

breaker.condition: The registry selects Aqua for Codex or does not select the npm provider.

added.statement: Each declared dotfiles mise upgrade path shall run mise install, mise upgrade, and mise reshim in that order.
acceptance_criteria: justfile mise-upgrade has the ordered sequence
scripts/repo-maintenance.sh mise-upgrade has the ordered sequence
home/modules/mise-auto-update.nix has the ordered sequence
the focused static test fails before these sequences are corrected

ears.response: refresh mise shims after installing and upgrading managed tools

breaker.condition: Any declared update path omits reshim or executes it before install or upgrade.

added.statement: The scheduled mise update service shall expose the Nix Node runtime before it invokes an npm-provider update.
acceptance_criteria: home/modules/mise-auto-update.nix includes the Nix Node bin path in the service PATH
the static test rejects a service PATH without Node
the maintenance-service trace shows Node resolves for the update process

ears.precondition: an npm-managed Codex update is scheduled
ears.response: make the declared Nix Node runtime available to the mise process

breaker.condition: The service depends on an ambient Node path or fails to resolve Node.

added.statement: After an authorized Home Manager activation, the active Codex mise install shall contain an executable codex-code-mode-host sibling and the managed wrapper shall resolve the refreshed Codex version.

mise install and mise reshim complete under the activated environment
codex --version resolves through the managed wrapper
the expected helper path is executable in the active npm Codex installation

ears.system: Authorized Home Manager and mise activation
ears.response: make the Codex executable and its code-mode helper available together

breaker.condition: The active Codex executable lacks an executable code-mode helper sibling after the declared update sequence.

test_plan.description: Extend the Nix tooling static test with a provider-selection assertion that fails against the Aqua baseline.
Extend the Nix tooling static test to require install, upgrade, then reshim in each declared update entrypoint.
